purpose: Small regression sentinel set for a one-market attended candidate; add mutations affected by the change. This is not full-catalogue or live qualification.

mutations.M-ES6-FLAG: Explicit live invocation is one required write key.
mutations.M-ES6-SENTINEL: The revocable sentinel is the other required write key.
mutations.M-ES6-RECHECK: Revocation is checked again at dispatch.
mutations.M-ES6-NOGUARD: The production REST composition actually uses the guard.
mutations.M-R-CANCEL-SHARD-ROUTE: Cancels reach the selected market shard and absence is verified.
mutations.M-D2-RELEASE-UNKNOWN: A cancel sweep cannot erase ambiguous create exposure.
mutations.M-D2-PLACE-BEFORE-FRESH-TRUTH: Replacement reduction waits for reconciled inventory.
mutations.M-D2-DRAIN-WITHOUT-CANCEL-TRUTH: Stale flat inventory cannot falsely prove drain after cancel.
mutations.M-Y3Q-GATESTOPCAP: Aggregate reducer size stays capped outside gate failure too.
mutations.M-2T6-RUNGOFF: The canary stops adding after first directional entry.
mutations.M-2T6-NOACK: An acknowledgement carrying a fill also stops the canary.
mutations.M-GP8-NOWIRE: The loss floor reaches the durable stop while reduction remains available.
mutations.M5a: Orders remain post-only on the actual wire body.
mutations.M20: A reported stop is durable and survives restart.
mutations.M-3AF-RESUME: Restart cannot silently clear a latched stop.
mutations.M-2W3-WIDE-TOLERANCE: A real 0.01-contract book-size difference is still an F5 disagreement.
mutations.M-2MZ-STEP-TOLERANCE: Float residue of any step count is not an F5 disagreement.
